meta.description: Phase 4-6 of PLAN.md. TikTok ORDER_STATUS_CHANGE webhook -> HMAC verify -> Get Order Detail -> status filter -> dedupe -> append to Orders sheet -> Telegram alert. Import into n8n, then fill in the TikTok, Google Sheets and Telegram credentials.

nodes.name: Verify Signature (HMAC)
nodes.notes: Rejects the request unless x-tts-signature matches HMAC-SHA256(body, TIKTOK_APP_SECRET). See TikTok Shop Partner Center docs for the exact signing spec (some events sign body+path+timestamp instead of raw body - confirm against the docs for your subscribed event type).

nodes.name: Ack Webhook
nodes.notes: TikTok expects a fast 200 response. Respond immediately, then keep processing in the rest of this workflow (n8n runs both branches from Verify Signature).

nodes.name: Build Signed Request
nodes.notes: Placeholder signing logic - confirm the exact path, query params and canonical string format against the current TikTok Shop Open API docs for the Get Order Detail endpoint before going live.

nodes.name: Status Filter
nodes.notes: Only CONFIRMED / AWAITING_SHIPMENT orders continue to the sheet + alert. Adjust the regex if TikTok's status enum differs from your shop's config.
